mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows the model to produce a state where two audit entries for the same task share identical (task, op, actor, actorRole, team) tuples — exactly the fingerprint of an in-place mutation or duplicate-overwrite. The injection forces two structurally identical entries to exist, which both assertions should catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some disj ae1, ae2: AuditEntry | ae1.auditTask = ae2.auditTask and ae1.auditOp = ae2.auditOp and ae1.auditActor = ae2.auditActor and ae1.auditActorRole = ae2.auditActorRole and ae1.auditTeam = ae2.auditTeam }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a Mutation with opKind=PatchSharedWith whose caller is not the task owner. The injection forces exactly this situation — a non-owner mutation against shared_with — which both assertions should catch as a violation of the owner-only share-control invariant.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NonOwnerShareControl { some m: Mutation | m.mutOpKind = PatchSharedWith and m.mutCaller != m.mutTask.taskOwner }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a task's sharedWith set to contain a user from a different team, violating the cross-team isolation invariant. The injection forces a sharee from a foreign team to appear in a task's share list.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CrossTeamSharee { some t: Task | some s: t.sharedWith | s.userTeam != t.taskTeam }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a Mutation with an empty mutAuditEntries set, meaning a successful state change produced no audit record. The injection forces a mutation with no audit entries, which both audit-completeness assertions should catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MissingAuditEntry { some m: Mutation | no m.mutAuditEntries }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows an audit entry whose snapshotted actorRole differs from the actor user's actual role — a misattribution. The injection forces a mismatch between the recorded role and the actor's real role.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_RoleMismatch { some ae: AuditEntry | ae.auditActorRole != ae.auditActor.userRole }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows the permission matrix to grant an Outsider access to GetTask (or any task-level operation), violating the cross-team byte-equivalent isolation contract. The injection directly inserts an Outsider → GetTask allow cell into the matrix.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OutsiderLeak { Outsider -> GetTask in PermMatrix.Allowed }
